title: Pardons Joseph Occhipinti
description_short: Trump granted a presidential pardon to Joseph Occhipinti as part of a clemency list.
description_medium: The Justice Department’s clemency list records President Donald Trump’s pardon of Joseph Occhipinti. It identifies a Southern District of New York case with a 37-month sentence, later commuted to time served in 1993, for conspiracy to violate civil rights, deprivation of rights and false statements. The list does not explain Trump’s reason for the pardon.

preserved_fields.title: Pardons Joseph Occhipinti
preserved_fields.description_short: Trump granted a presidential pardon to Joseph Occhipinti as part of a clemency list.

notes: The linked Justice Department list confirms a pardon and supplies the underlying Southern District of New York offenses and sentence history: 37 months, reduced to time served in 1993, plus two years of supervised release. It does not describe the civil-rights case or explain the pardon decision; a case narrative or contemporaneous clemency rationale is needed for a substantive long account.

title: Pardons Faustino Bernadett
description_short: Trump granted a presidential pardon to Faustino Bernadett as part of a clemency list.
description_medium: The Justice Department lists President Donald Trump’s pardon of Faustino Bernadett in a Central District of California case involving misprision of a felony. The record shows a 15-month prison term, one year of supervised release and a $60,000 fine, with surrender scheduled for February 2021. It gives no account of the underlying conduct or pardon rationale.

title: Pardons James E. Johnson, Jr.
description_short: Trump granted a presidential pardon to James E. Johnson, Jr. as part of a clemency list.
description_medium: The Justice Department’s clemency list records President Donald Trump’s pardon of James E. Johnson Jr. in an Eastern District of North Carolina case. It lists a conviction for hunting over bait and killing a migratory game bird, with one year of probation and a $7,500 fine. The table gives no further case circumstances or reason for clemency.

title: Commutes Sentence of Mark Shapiro
description_short: Trump commuted the sentence of Mark Shapiro as part of a clemency list.
description_medium: The Justice Department’s commutations list records President Donald Trump’s reduction of Mark Shapiro’s sentence in a Southern District of New York fraud case. It lists 1,020 months in prison, three years of supervised release and more than $22 million in restitution for securities, wire and mail fraud offenses. The table does not describe the scheme or the reason for commutation.

title: Judge strikes down Trump administration's 75-country immigrant-visa suspension
description_short: Judge strikes down Trump administration's 75-country immigrant-visa suspension
description_medium: On Aug. 21, 2026, a federal judge struck down the Trump administration's suspension of immigrant-visa issuance for applicants from 75 countries. Reuters reported that the court found the policy exceeded the secretary of state's authority. The ruling addressed the government's authority to impose the suspension; it did not establish that every affected application was immediately approved.

preserved_fields.title: Judge strikes down Trump administration's 75-country immigrant-visa suspension
preserved_fields.description_short: Judge strikes down Trump administration's 75-country immigrant-visa suspension

notes: The supplied Reuters summary dates the court action to August 21, 2026; August 22 is the publication date. It reports that the judge found the 75-country immigrant-visa suspension exceeded the secretary of state's authority.
